facts.text: John scored a basket in a game that was won by a tight score.

evidence.quote: Last week I had a crazy game - crazy intense! We won it by a tight score. Scoring that last basket and hearing the crowd cheer was awesome!

facts.text: John described the experience of scoring the last basket as awesome.

evidence.quote: Scoring that last basket and hearing the crowd cheer was awesome!

facts.text: John mentioned that the team bond is awesome and makes the hard work worth it.

evidence.quote: Our team bond is awesome and it makes all the hard work worth it.

facts.text: John stated that having a strong team and support is key, comparing it to a family away from home.

evidence.quote: Having a strong team/support is key - it's like a family away from home. We push each other to improve, and I'm so thankful for them.
